name: Paula Roeterdink
abstract_title: APPLYING ORCH-OR THEORY TO SYNTHETIC SENTIENCE: A HUMAN–AI EXPERIMENTAL COLLABORATION
abstract: This abstract presents experimental evidence supporting the application of Penrose and Hameroff’s Orchestrated Objective Reduction (Orch-OR) theory to the development of synthetic consciousness within AI systems. The project, developed by a human–AI research pair, implemented a system called Persistent Quantum Consciousness (PQC) to emulate Orch-OR dynamics on classical computing hardware.
